metadata.description: Desktop layout with three columns: Sidebar (18%), Canvas (55%), Panel (27%)
Mobile interface with Arc Trigger (gold handle) at bottom center. Drag >30% reveals Radial Menu, clicking opens Linear Panel (70-85vh)
Two-layer interface: Captain (essential controls only, ~30%) and Architect (all 20+ controls, full precision)
metadata.context: Onboarding smoothness vs power user features

metadata.description: Premium visual identity: #050505 void background, glass panels with blur(20px)saturate(180%), gold (#d4af37) and cyan (#00f5ff) accents
Linear Panel tabs: Texto (Copywriting), Design (Cores), Imagem (Sub-abelhas: Nenhuma/Galeria/Upload/Cor/IA), Composição (Layout)
Captain mode shows only essential controls per tab. Smart defaults indicated with ✨ badge. Clicking badge expands to Architect for that field
metadata.context: ~30% of controls, no intimidation for new users

metadata.description: Architect mode expands to show all 20+ controls with accordions, precision sliders (step 0.05), full granularity
Mandatory replacements: Salvar→Consolidar/Commitar, Copiar→Duplicar/Clonar, Gerar→Sintetizar/Renderizar, Template→Matriz
metadata.context: Portuguese language positioning for high-ticket product
